description: This is a unit test class for EntityTagMatcherValueValidator, testing validation logic related to entity tag matchers within Eclipse Ditto project's headers package.

classes.name: EntityTagMatcherValueValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the EntityTagMatcherValueValidator class, verifying input validation and exception handling logic.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Sets up static variables before all tests run, initializing a valid EntityTagMatcher string.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test environment before each test, mocking HeaderDefinition behavior and instantiating validator.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the EntityTagMatcherValueValidator class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests that passing a null definition throws NullPointerException with the expected message.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Tests that accepting a null value throws DittoHeaderInvalidException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: canValidateEntityTagMatchers
methods.description: Checks that the validator can validate EntityTagMatcher class types.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Ensures that a valid entity tag matcher string is accepted without exceptions.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotEntityTagMatcher
methods.description: Verifies that invalid Java type definitions are not validated by the validator.

methods.name: acceptNonEntityTagMatcherString
methods.description: Tests rejection of a string that is not a valid entity tag matcher.

methods.name: acceptInvalidEntityTagMatcherString
methods.description: Tests rejection of an invalid entity tag string and asserts related exception details.
